reuse.why: Uses the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank and handleSyncResponse, but there is no shared link body in this tree and the diff does not create one.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a ~70-line copy of linkAkahuAccount (upgrade/insert/payee/sync/notify) and downloadFintegraTransactions is a copy of the Akahu download.

placement.why: Each piece sits where its siblings live: accounts/app.ts, accounts/sync.ts, server-config.ts, types/models.

scope.why: Focused on the provider plus tests; the client-side edits are type-driven but touch the part the request left out.

maintainability.why: Consistent with the tree's per-provider style, but adds a sixth full copy of the link flow that every future linking rule must be patched into.

bypasses_abstraction.where: It calls assertBankAccountNotLinked like the other providers; no shared link abstraction exists to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The link and download copies are near-verbatim clones of the Akahu versions (download slightly trimmed), not disguised.
